name: 林小羊
audience: 熟悉朋友、共享玩梗语境的小群
purpose: 把脑内状态画成荒诞的身体动作，保留羊的身份和可读文案

stickers.caption: 我裂开了
stickers.usage_note: 夸张自嘲；不作为严肃危机回应
stickers.pose: Sheep's wool body splits into two soft cushion halves horizontally with a narrow gap, tiny face and curled horns remain on top half, short hooves on bottom half, dots stare in disbelief. Harmless cartoon toy separation, no injury or gore, no extra limbs.

stickers.caption: 脑子打结
stickers.pose: Sheep wool body turns into ONE comical pretzel-shaped soft knot, head with two curl horns and ears clearly at upper center, hooves poke out lower ends, tiny perplexed eyes. Big readable knot hole, simple linework.

stickers.caption: 原地起飞
stickers.usage_note: 通过腾空夸张回应好消息
stickers.pose: Sheep stretches into a tall narrow fluffy rocket-like body, feet tucked upward and ears spread, tiny delighted face, two curved takeoff swooshes below with no fire. High vertical silhouette, no rocket machine.

stickers.caption: 已变成饼
stickers.pose: Sheep squashed into an absurdly thin wide oval wool pancake, face sideways on front edge, horns lie floppy at sides, tiny hooves spread flat; body thickness barely one quarter its width.

stickers.caption: 反复横跳
stickers.usage_note: 调侃自己的摇摆，不代替明确选择
stickers.pose: ONE central sheep jumping sideways with long splayed hooves and a startled happy blank face, two faint pale offset outline afterimages only at left and right, clear motion arrows to suggest ping-pong. No clone heads or extra solid limbs.

stickers.caption: 快乐到变形
stickers.pose: Sheep body bends into a ridiculous U-shaped wool noodle, head tilted sideways, open laughing mouth simple, hooves flung in opposite directions, two tiny tears of laughter, no cruel scene.

stickers.caption: 灵魂出窍
stickers.usage_note: 喜剧性的发懵，不等同于医疗或心理诊断
stickers.pose: Floppy sheep body sits inert like a pile of wool, above it ONE small semi-transparent pale outline of the same sheep floats upward, both tiny dot eyes blank, only one physical sheep and one simple soul outline. Gentle silly not horror.

stickers.caption: 好耶
stickers.usage_note: 可单独表达开心，不需解释梗
stickers.pose: Sheep becomes a tall elastic fluffy bean leaping with both hooves high and ears raised, big simple open happy mouth, tiny dot eyes. Silly uneven celebratory pose, three small warm yellow starbursts, not elaborate.
